titulo: A hair salon's website, before and after
hooks: Your client wants to book at midnight
voz: Booking by phone only, photos from years ago and an outdated price list. That way nobody can book at night, which is when people remember they need a cut. In the new version, you see the work first and then a button to book the time that works for you.

despues.titular: Your next cut, two taps away

captions: Your clients remember to book at night, phone in hand. If you only take appointments by phone during business hours, that booking is gone.
Photos of your work sell better than any description. Put them right at the top, nice and big, and keep the booking button one tap away.
A years-old price list on your website brings more arguments than appointments. If your prices change often, your website has to keep up just as fast.
